The [[primary elections]] for the [[Republican Party of Oklahoma|Republican]], [[Democratic Party of Oklahoma|Democratic]], and [[Libertarian Party of Oklahoma|Libertarian]] parties' nominations took place on June 18, 2024. All candidates had to file between the days of April 3–5, 2024.{{cite web |title=2024 Statutory Election Dates and Deadlines |url=https://oklahoma.gov/content/dam/ok/en/elections/dates-and-deadlines/2024-statutory-election-dates-deadlines.pdf |website=oklahoma.gov |publisher=[[Oklahoma State Election Board]] |access-date=14 July 2023}} The elections were part of the [[2024 Oklahoma elections]] and coincided with the [[2024 United States presidential election|2024 U.S. presidential election]], as well as [[2024 United States House of Representatives elections|other elections]] to the House of Representatives, [[2024 United States Senate elections|elections]] to the [[United States Senate]], and various [[2024 United States elections|state and local elections]]. {{Horizontal TOC|nonum=yes|limit=2}} ==District 1== {{Infobox election | election_name = 2024 Oklahoma's 1st congressional district election | country = Oklahoma | type = presidential | ongoing = no | previous_election = 2022 United States House of Representatives elections in Oklahoma#District 1 | previous_year = 2022 | election_date = | next_election = 2026 United States House of Representatives elections in Oklahoma#District 1 | next_year = 2026 | image_size = x150px | image1 = Rep.
